app.name: meetstream
app.label: MeetStream
app.description: Create meeting bots, retrieve transcripts and recordings, and watch meeting events.

400.message: [400] Check the meeting URL, options, and scheduled join time. Scheduled times must be in the future.

401.message: [401] Update the API key in your MeetStream connection.

403.message: [403] Check your MeetStream API key, account permissions, credits, and resource ownership. This can be a resource or credit restriction even when the connection is valid.

404.message: [404] The resource was not found or the artifact is not ready. Verify the ID and wait for the corresponding processed event.

409.message: [409] The deduplication key belongs to a different meeting, or transcription was not enabled. Check the bot configuration.

429.message: [429] MeetStream is throttling requests or has no available signed-in login. Retry-After: {{ifempty(get(headers, 'retry-after'), 'not supplied')}}. Use a bounded retry policy and check signed-in bot capacity.

507.message: [507] MeetStream returned an Idempotency-Key replay. Do not retry it. Use Create a Bot with a Deduplication Key for native Make replay handling.

error.message: [{{statusCode}}] MeetStream could not complete this request. Check the module inputs and service status.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.label: API Key
parameters.help: Create an API key at https://app.meetstream.ai/api-key. Paste only the key; MeetStream adds the Token prefix.

401.message: [401] The MeetStream API key is invalid. Get a key at app.meetstream.ai/api-key.

403.message: [403] MeetStream rejected this key. Check the key and workspace access.

error.message: [{{statusCode}}] Could not verify this MeetStream connection. Check your API key and try again.

parameters.name: relaySecret
parameters.label: Relay Signing Key
parameters.help: Store the shared relay signing key here, never in a scenario mapper. This is distinct from the MeetStream workspace signing secret.

verification.condition: {{if(method == 'POST' && body.delivery_id && body.payload && body.signature == sha256(body.delivery_id + ':' + body.issued_at + ':' + body.payload, 'hex', parameters.relaySecret) && parseDate(body.issued_at, 'X') >= addSeconds(now, -300) && parseDate(body.issued_at, 'X') <= addSeconds(now, 300), false, true)}}

metadata.name: createBot
metadata.label: Create a Bot
metadata.description: Creates or schedules a meeting bot with a stable deduplication key.

expect.name: deduplicationKey
expect.label: Deduplication Key
expect.help: Use one stable key per logical meeting, such as a calendar ID plus event occurrence ID. Reuse it on retries. Serialize creation: simultaneous first calls can create duplicates.

metadata.name: getBot
metadata.label: Get a Bot
metadata.description: Retrieves bot details and current status.

metadata.name: getTranscriptions
metadata.label: List Transcriptions
metadata.description: Lists transcription jobs and their transcript IDs for a bot.

metadata.name: getLatestTranscription
metadata.label: Get the Latest Successful Transcription
metadata.description: Retrieves the latest completed post-call transcription ID for a bot.

valid.message: No successful post-call transcription is ready. Wait for transcription.processed, then try again. Caption and live providers use separate artifacts.

metadata.name: getTranscript
metadata.label: Get a Transcript
metadata.description: Retrieves transcript text, segments, and metadata by transcript ID.

output.text: {{if(substring(createJSON(get(item, 'transcript')), 0, 1) == '"' && trim(get(item, 'transcript')), get(item, 'transcript'), if(replace(createJSON(remove(map(remove(get(item, 'words'), null), 'text'), null)), '/^\[(?:"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"(?:,"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")*)?\]$/', '') == '', join(remove(map(remove(get(item, 'words'), null), 'text'), null), ' '), ''))}}

metadata.name: getSummary
metadata.label: Get a Summary
metadata.description: Retrieves a completed summary when supported; rejects processing and empty responses.

valid.message: No completed summary was returned. HTTP 202 means processing; retry later with a bounded policy. An empty 200 response is not a completed summary.

metadata.name: getRecording
metadata.label: Get a Recording
metadata.description: Retrieves video metadata and a fresh download URL valid for one hour.

valid.message: Recording is not ready or has no valid HTTPS download URL. Enable video recording, wait for video.processed with Success, and check media retention before fetching a fresh URL.

metadata.name: leaveMeeting

expect.name: url
expect.label: URL
expect.help: Enter a path relative to https://api.meetstream.ai, for example /api/v1/bots. Put query parameters below. External hosts and redirects are blocked.

expect.name: body
expect.label: Body
expect.help: Optional JSON request body. You are responsible for the method, path, and body. Writes can change meetings and incur charges. Do not put credentials here.

metadata.name: watchMeetingEvents
metadata.label: Watch Meeting Events
metadata.description: Receives verified meeting lifecycle and artifact events through the MeetStream relay.

parameters.title: Connect a verified workspace webhook
parameters.text: Use the included verification relay. Copy this webhook URL into the relay configuration, and register the relay HTTPS URL at app.meetstream.ai/webhooks. Set the same relay signing key in this webhook and the relay secrets. Subscribe to transcription.processed, video.processed, bot.done and all five ending events. See the setup guide. Do not send unsigned per-bot callbacks directly to this trigger.
